:::{#exr-matadd-commutative-proof}
#### Proving that matrix addition is commutative

@thm-matadd-commutative lets two [matrices](#def-matrix) be added in either order,
just as two numbers can be
([sums are symmetric](algebra-sums.qmd#thm-sum-symmetric)).

Prove @thm-matadd-commutative.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Two $m \times n$ [matrices](#def-matrix) are equal when their $(i, j)$ entries agree for every $i$ and $j$.
Express the $(i, j)$ entry of each side with @def-matrix-addition.
